# Grouped Batches, Unknown Group Size

Known-truth simulated items for studying how to choose the settings of test-time rules that read a whole batch
(centring scores or features inside groups) when the test batch's group sizes are unknown.

**Provenance.** Fully synthetic, generated by `bmv/sim.py` of the batch-matched-validation repository (code embedded
in the companion notebook, `locdunhat/validating-test-time-centring-for-the-test-batch`). No real people, text or
external data.

**Generation.** 18 authors (classes). An item by author k in group g has style features x = mu[k] + u[g] + e in 16
dimensions (mu[k] ~ N(0, 0.75^2), u[g] ~ N(0, 1), e ~ N(0, 1)) and content features c = v[g] + 1.5 n in 100
dimensions (v[g], n ~ N(0, 1)), which only say which group the item belongs to. Authors inside a group are all
different. Seed 20261027.

**Files.**
- `worlds.parquet`: two worlds, `all_2` (test groups of two items) and `mixed_1-18` (test group sizes 1, 2, 3, 6, 12,
  18 with probabilities 0.25, 0.25, 0.2, 0.15, 0.1, 0.05). Each has `train` (150 groups of 18), `validation` (100
  groups of 18) and `test` (about 1,800 items).
- `exp1_scenarios.csv`, `exp2_validation_size.csv`, `exp3_group_effect.csv`: the result tables of the three sweeps
  (regret of six selection rules, standard errors, most frequent choices).

**Columns of worlds.parquet.** `world`, `split`, `label` (author 0 to 17), `group` (true group id within the split;
treat it as hidden on the test split), `x_0` to `x_15` (style), `c_0` to `c_99` (content).

**License.** CC0 1.0.

**Intended use.** Benchmarking how validation choices for transductive test-time rules transfer to a test batch
with a different group structure; teaching material on grouped validation.

**Known limitations.** The group effect is a purely additive Gaussian shift and content is independent of the
author. Real data (for example LLM-authorship passages grouped by prompt) have partly non-additive topic effects and
content that correlates with the author.
